decks.notes: The deck revolves around assembling and utilizing the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate value and create an overwhelming board presence. It includes cards like Esika's Chariot and Raffine's Informant to support the combo and cards like Scrapwork Mutt and Witherbloom Command for additional synergy. The deck also features cards for disruption and card selection like Thoughtseize and Grisly Salvage, as well as mana fixing lands to ensure consistency in casting the combo pieces. The key strategy is to efficiently assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence using low-cost creatures like Llanowar Elves and Lovestruck Beast, while also utilizing powerful spells like The Akroan War and Embercleave to control the board and push damage through. The inclusion of cards like Migloz, Maze Crusher and Voldaren Thrillseeker provides additional threats and versatility in combat. The land base is designed to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed for the deck's efficient curve and powerful spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive early game plays, utilizing low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Thraben Inspector to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also includes powerful synergy cards like Venerated Loxodon and Resolute Reinforcements to buff up your creatures for a strong attack. With cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Gleeful Demolition to finish off the opponent, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures while maintaining some late-game presence with cards like Knight-Errant of Eos and Regal Leosaur.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption to control the board. By using powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent quickly. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Misery's Shadow adds additional versatility and threat potential, making it a formidable deck in one-on-one Pioneer matchups.

The key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent using low-cost aggressive creatures and combat tricks, supported by disruption and protection spells. By efficiently deploying threats and utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to pump up the team, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The deck also includes utility creatures like General Kudro of Drannith for added synergy and disruption with cards like Dire Tactics for removal. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while providing consistent access to all colors needed for the deck.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells to dominate the early game and maintain pressure on the opponent. With a mix of efficient removal, hand disruption, and resilient threats, it aims to outpace the opponent and close out the game quickly. By utilizing a combination of efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and powerful spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck looks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast clock to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures and disruption spells. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while also attacking aggressively with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized to allow for a smooth curve and consistent access to the necessary colors for the spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Retraction Helix combo to generate value and control the board. The deck includes a mix of cards that can draw, search, and disrupt the opponent's plays, with key cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Rona, Herald of Invasion supporting the combo. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Thoughseize helps to maintain board control and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to consistently assemble the combo pieces and outvalue the opponent to secure a win.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation and Fires of Invention to control the game and generate value by sacrificing creatures to tutor for powerful threats from the deck. The inclusion of a wide variety of creatures with varying abilities allows for flexibility in the threats the deck can present, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Chained to the Rocks and Deputy of Detention. The deck aims to slowly grind out advantages while maintaining control of the board and ultimately overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats.

The main focus of this Izzet Control deck is to control the board through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage while building up to powerful finishers like Alrund's Epiphany and Chandra, Hope's Beacon. The deck also utilizes various modal spells like Prismari Command and Dig Through Time to provide flexibility in different situations. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the spells while also including utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent through a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By utilizing cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan and slowly grind them down. The deck also has a strong mana base with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to ensure it can cast its powerful spells consistently. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game and dominate the opponent with its strong creatures and removal suite.

The deck focuses on utilizing a diverse array of powerful multicolored cards to control the game and out-value opponents. With Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the centerpiece, the deck aims to consistently draw gas and stay ahead of the opponent's threats. The inclusion of cards like Bring to Light and Leyline Binding provides flexibility and answers to a variety of situations, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad offers additional value and card advantage. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistent access to all of its powerful spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells in order to quickly deplete their life total. By utilizing powerful removal like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, along with hand disruption from cards like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to apply pressure. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional ways to close out the game quickly and efficiently.

This Red Deck Wins Pioneer 1 vs 1 deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key strategy revolves around playing low-cost and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, while also utilizing burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to finish off opponents or clear the board. Chandra planeswalkers provide additional burn and card advantage, and lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins contribute to the aggressive game plan by providing additional threats.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's plays while generating card advantage through card draw effects like Memory Deluge and Narset, Parter of Veils. Supreme Verdict and Fateful Absence provide removal options for threats on the board, while Teferi, Hero of Dominaria allows for card advantage and tempo advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Strict Proctor and Discontinuity to further hinder the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent while maintaining a solid board presence.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, wiping the board with Supreme Verdict, and disrupting their plans with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also utilizes Discontinuity to manipulate the stack and Fateful Absence for removal. Memory Deluge provides card advantage, while Strict Proctor helps to shut down opponent's plays. The mana base includes lands that provide flexibility, allowing the player to adapt to different situations and control the flow of the game effectively.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost creatures like Ornithopter and Burning-Tree Emissary, then pumping them up with cards like Venerated Loxodon and Reckless Bushwhacker to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Clarion Spirit and Legion Loyalist provide additional benefits for going wide with creatures, while cards like Gleeful Demolition offer removal options. The deck aims to apply pressure early and often, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost creatures and use them to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Cards like Burning-Tree Emissary and Reckless Bushwhacker allow for explosive starts, while cards like Knight-Errant of Eos and Venerated Loxodon provide additional support and pump effects. Ultimately, the goal is to maintain a fast-paced, aggressive strategy to win the game swiftly.

This deck focuses on using ramp strategies to quickly bring out powerful creatures and spells while controlling the opponent's actions through removal and disruption. The key concept is to accelerate mana production with cards like Sylvan Caryatid and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while using Bring to Light to search for key spells like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines or Extinction Event. The deck also utilizes Leyline Binding to lock down the opponent's key threats and Chained to the Rocks for targeted removal. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides additional mana fixing and utility.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels quickly. It also includes a variety of spells to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to surprise opponents with unexpected plays and overwhelm them with powerful threats. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Make Disappear adds a unique twist to the strategy, providing additional flexibility and unpredictability to the deck's game plan.

The deck also leverages versatile spells like Prismari Command and Magma Opus to deal with threats and generate card advantage. The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage.
